fields.label: Context ID
fields.description: Unique ID, e.g. WK_MU2025_C01. Create a new context when the reaction mode, metal or conditions change.

fields.label: Discovery event ID
fields.description: Group one reported reaction capability. Substrates and variants are not separate discoveries; cross-paper events will be reconciled later.

fields.label: DOI or public URL
fields.description: Original article DOI or permanent preprint URL. Prefer the primary experimental source.

fields.label: Source location
fields.description: Main text or SI page, figure/table and entry. Locate the specific conditions or measurement, not only the paper.

fields.label: Reaction name
fields.description: Use the reaction name reported by the authors.

fields.label: Catalysis type
fields.description: Classify the catalyst actually used in this experiment.

fields.label: Protein scaffold
fields.description: Required for enzymatic records; enter Not reported if unknown. Put the variant in Measurements.

fields.label: Actual metal and cofactor
fields.description: Record the experimental metal/cofactor or added salt. Do not infer the active oxidation state from the salt alone.

fields.label: Conditions as reported
fields.description: Keep the reported buffer, pH, temperature, time, concentrations, additives and amounts, with units. Details can be separated later.

fields.label: Review status
fields.description: Use Needs review during collection. Reviewed requires checking structures, conditions and sources. Example is always excluded from retrieval.

fields.label: Paper title
fields.description: Title as published.

fields.label: Research group
fields.description: PI name and/or institution for coverage tracking.

fields.label: Earliest public date
fields.description: YYYY-MM-DD after checking preprints and journal versions. If only a year is known, leave blank and put the year in Notes.

fields.label: Date evidence URL
fields.description: Source supporting the earliest verified public date. A journal date alone does not establish that no earlier preprint exists.

fields.label: Bond formation classes
fields.description: Separate multiple labels with semicolons: C-C; C-N; C-O; C-S; C-Si; other. These labels do not establish mechanism.

fields.label: Native metal and cofactor
fields.description: Record native Fe separately from experimental Cu, for example. Leave unknown values blank.

fields.label: Metal installation method
fields.description: Describe salt addition, metal substitution, complex incorporation or reconstitution as reported.

fields.label: Enzyme preparation
fields.description: Purified enzyme, lysate, whole cells, etc.

fields.label: Buffer and pH
fields.description: Buffer identity, concentration and pH. Leave unreported information blank.

fields.label: Solvent and composition
fields.description: Water/cosolvent composition with units, e.g. volume fraction.

fields.label: Temperature (C)
fields.description: Single numerical value in degrees Celsius. Preserve room temperature or a range in the original conditions; do not guess.

fields.label: Duration (h)
fields.description: Numerical hours. Keep the original time and unit in Conditions as reported.

fields.label: Additives and light/redox setup
fields.description: Ligands, electron donors, oxidants/reductants, wavelength/power, atmosphere and quantities.

fields.label: Substrate and catalyst loading
fields.description: Substrate concentration, enzyme/metal loading and equivalents, with units.

fields.label: Activation or intermediate
fields.description: Optional. If populated, provide evidence type and a specific source location.

fields.label: Mechanistic evidence type
fields.description: Keep experimental support, the authors proposal and a project hypothesis distinct.

fields.label: Mechanistic evidence location
fields.description: Page, figure, table or link supporting the mechanism; explain the reasoning for a project hypothesis.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Uncertainties, alternative names, provenance, scope or additional details.

fields.label: Measurement ID
fields.description: Unique per row, e.g. WK_MU2025_A01_YIELD.

fields.label: Assay ID
fields.description: Share across metrics from the same experiment. Change for a different substrate, variant or independent replicate.

fields.label: Context ID
fields.description: Unique ID, e.g. WK_MU2025_C01. Create a new context when the reaction mode, metal or conditions change.

fields.label: Source location
fields.description: Main text or SI page, figure/table and entry. Locate the specific conditions or measurement, not only the paper.

fields.label: Reactant and product labels
fields.description: Paper labels, e.g. 1a + 2b -> 3ab. In an undetected experiment, identify the tested target without claiming it formed.

fields.label: Experimental stage
fields.description: Distinguish initial activity, variants during screening, evolved outcomes, substrate scope and controls.

fields.label: Product detection status
fields.description: Not detected applies only to the measured product in that experiment. An unreported experiment is not a negative result.

fields.label: Metric
fields.description: One metric per row. Yield and ee use separate rows with the same Assay ID.

fields.label: Numeric value
fields.description: For 85 percent enter the plain number 85, not Excel 85%. For <1 enter 1 and qualifier <. Unknown stays blank; zero must be reported.

fields.label: Qualifier
fields.description: Required when Numeric value is populated. Use ~ for an approximate value. Do not treat a bound as an exact measurement.

fields.label: Unit
fields.description: Required for a numeric value. Use % for yield/conversion/ee and turnovers for TTN.

fields.label: Result as reported
fields.description: Preserve the original expression, e.g. >99% ee, 95:5 dr or n.d. Required when Numeric value is blank.

fields.label: Enzyme variant
fields.description: Reported variant name/mutations. Use Not reported if unspecified; may be blank for nonenzymatic controls.

fields.label: Reaction SMILES
fields.description: reactants>agents>products or reactants>>products. Preserve stereochemistry. Atom mapping is not required; structures can be added later.

fields.label: Structure status
fields.description: Only Reviewed structures enter default retrieval. Never invent an unreported product.

fields.label: Product role
fields.description: Use Tested target when the structure describes an intended product in an undetected reaction or control.

fields.label: Measurement method
fields.description: Isolated yield, GC, HPLC, NMR, chiral method, standards, etc.

fields.label: Replicate count
fields.description: Positive integer only when reported. Individual replicate values may use separate Assay IDs.

fields.label: Uncertainty as reported
fields.description: For example mean +/- SD, n=3. Keep SD and SEM distinct.

fields.label: Sequence or database accession
fields.description: UniProt, PDB, GenBank, etc. Can be added later.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Uncertainties, alternative names, provenance, scope or additional details.
